items.headline: Yankees flatten the Red Sox 9-0 — and now it's do-or-die for Boston
items.body: The dream matchup opened with a beatdown. Cam Schlittler spun 6.1 shutout innings and Ben Rice launched two homers as the Yankees blanked Boston 9-0 in Game 1 of the AL Wild Card. It wasn't the only laugher on Day 1 — the Padres shut out the Cubs 8-0 and the White Sox stunned the Astros. Now Boston faces a win-or-go-home Game 2 tonight.
items.say: The Yankees-Red Sox playoff series kicked off and the Yankees absolutely dumpstered them, 9-0. Now it's do-or-die for Boston tonight. These win-or-go-home rounds are the best. You got a team still alive?

items.headline: Party crashed — Panthers spoil Carolina's banner night with an OT dagger
items.body: Hockey's back, and opening night was cruel to the champs. The Hurricanes raised their first-ever Stanley Cup banner… and then Gustav Forsling one-timed home the winner with 4.3 seconds left in overtime to give Florida a 1-0 win in Carolina. Elsewhere, hyped 18-year-old No. 1 pick Gavin McKenna had a quiet debut (a minus-2) in Toronto's 3-2 loss to Montreal.
items.say: Hockey's back — and on opening night the champs raised their banner and then lost 1-0 on a goal with four seconds left in overtime. Absolutely brutal. You follow the NHL at all, or more of a playoff-time person?

items.headline: History in Brooklyn — the 8-seed Liberty sweep the top-seeded Lynx out
items.body: They finished the shocker. New York wrapped up a two-game sweep of Minnesota with an 87-71 win, becoming the first No. 8 seed to ever knock out a No. 1 seed in WNBA history. The Liberty's big three — Jonquel Jones (21 & 13), Breanna Stewart (21) and Sabrina Ionescu (18) — combined for 60. On to the semifinals.
items.say: Remember that WNBA upset? The last-seeded Liberty finished the job and swept the No. 1 team right out — first time an 8-seed's ever done that. Playoff chaos is so good. You keep up with the W at all?

items.headline: AFC North grudge match — Steelers at Browns on Thursday night
items.body: Week 4 kicks off with an old-school rivalry: Pittsburgh visits Cleveland on Thursday night (Prime Video). These two always scrap regardless of the records, and it's the kind of chippy, low-scoring division game that sets the tone for the whole weekend.
items.say: Steelers-Browns kicks off Thursday night football this week — one of those nasty old division rivalries that's always a scrap. You riding with anybody this NFL season?

items.headline: CS is back on LAN — ESL Pro League returns to Katowice this weekend
items.body: For the Counter-Strike heads: ESL Pro League Season 24 fires up Saturday (Oct. 3) with 16 of the world's best teams and a $1M prize pool, building toward the playoffs in the legendary Spodek Arena in Katowice, Poland. Big stage, big stakes, and one of the best crowds in esports.
items.say: Big Counter-Strike tournament kicks off this weekend over in Poland — the Pro League, all the top teams, million-dollar prize. That Katowice crowd is unreal. You ever watch any esports, or is it a total mystery to you?

items.headline: Tom Cruise, unrecognizable — Iñárritu's 'Digger' opens Friday
items.body: The wildest swing of the fall movie season lands Friday: 'Digger,' with Tom Cruise transformed into a potbellied, comb-over oil baron in Alejandro G. Iñárritu's disaster-comedy satire. Cruise's tycoon sets off an ecological catastrophe and then scrambles to be hailed as the hero, backed by a stacked cast (Riz Ahmed, Sandra Hüller, Jesse Plemons, John Goodman). Early reviews call it a big, bonkers change of pace for him.
items.say: There's a new Tom Cruise movie Friday where he's completely unrecognizable — potbelly, comb-over, playing an oil tycoon in this crazy disaster satire. Wild to see him do something so different from the stunts. You a Cruise guy, or more of a wait-for-streaming person?

items.headline: A billion-dollar divorce turns brutal — HBO's 'War' premieres Thursday
items.body: One for the prestige-TV crowd: 'War' debuts Thursday on HBO Max, a glossy legal thriller with Dominic West as a tech titan and Sienna Miller as his movie-star wife, whose split becomes an all-out courtroom battle between London's most ruthless law firms. It's from 'Lupin' creator George Kay and landing strong reviews.
items.say: There's a new HBO show Thursday called 'War' — Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a mega-rich couple in the nastiest divorce imaginable, basically a legal thriller. Looks like a proper binge. You into the prestige-y stuff, or more comfort TV?

items.headline: Spooky season starts here — 'Coven Academy' kicks off 31 Nights of Halloween
items.body: Right on cue for October: 'Coven Academy' premieres Thursday on Freeform (streaming next day on Disney+ and Hulu), launching the network's 31 Nights of Halloween. It's a teen-witch drama set at a haunted New Orleans magic school — love triangles, ancient feuds, and a trailer scored to Olivia Rodrigo's 'Brutal.' '90s kids will clock Devon Sawa and Tiffani Thiessen in the cast, too.
items.say: Freeform's kicking off its Halloween lineup Thursday with a new teen-witch show set in New Orleans — feels like spooky season's officially here. You do the whole Halloween thing — decorations, scary movies — or skip it?

items.headline: Austin gets loud — ACL Festival Weekend 1 takes over Zilker Park
items.body: One of the year's big music weekends lands Friday: Austin City Limits Festival opens Weekend 1 (Oct. 2-4) at Zilker Park, with headliners Charli xcx, Twenty One Pilots, Lorde, Skrillex, The xx and dad-rock staples Kings of Leon across a nine-stage lineup. Peak festival-season vibes.
items.say: The big Austin City Limits festival kicks off this weekend — Kings of Leon, Twenty One Pilots, Lorde, all of them. Perfect excuse for a playlist refresh. You ever done a music festival, or is that a young-person's game now?
